english.meaning: to treat different things as if they were the same
english.note: Usually negated: 不能混為一談, cannot be treated as one thing.

exampleSentences.english: Bored and stupid aren’t the same thing, buddy.
exampleSentences.traditional: 無聊同戇居不能混為一談啊，老兄。
